brief:
A father and his sons are clearing the rubble of their destroyed home in Gaza using only basic tools, according to Al Jazeera English. With no access to heavy machinery or construction equipment, the family has resorted to hand implements as they work to salvage materials and clear debris from the site where their residence once stood.

The family's reliance on manual labor underscores the broader infrastructure challenges facing Gaza residents in the aftermath of widespread destruction. Across the territory, families confronted with demolished homes have struggled to remove rubble without adequate equipment or external support for debris clearance operations.
dek: Forced to rely on basic tools, a father and his sons are clearing the rubble of their destroyed home in Gaza.
title: Father and sons manually clear rubble of destroyed Gaza home
